# dropbox_sign

## DROPBOX_SIGN_ADD_USER_TO_TEAM
Tool to invite a user to your Team. Use when you need to add a member by email or account ID.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddUserToTeamRequest",
  "properties": {
    "role": {
      "enum": [
        "Member",
        "Developer",
        "Team Manager",
        "Admin"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Role",
      "description": "Role to assign to the invited user. Allowed values: Member, Developer, Team Manager, Admin."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "examples": [
        "f32ba4f0cda311e985b40a3fe3ad9f3f"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the team to which the user will be invited."
    },
    "account_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Account Id",
      "examples": [
        "d004ec4dc2194c5f9b4f0cda311e985b"
      ],
      "description": "The account ID of the user to invite. If provided, takes precedence over email_address."
    },
    "email_address": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Email Address",
      "format": "email",
      "examples": [
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "The email address of the user to invite. Required if account_id is not provided."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for inviting a user to a team.\nEither account_id or email_address must be provided."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_ADD_USER_TO_TEMPLATE
Tool to grant a specified account access to a template. Use when you need to share a template with another user after confirming template and account identifiers.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddUserToTemplateRequest",
  "required": [
    "template_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "account_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Account Id",
      "examples": [
        "a5be022c9f7f27139f1103d66a981e6e089ff22e"
      ],
      "maxLength": 40,
      "minLength": 40,
      "description": "ID of the account to grant access (must be 40 characters long). Takes precedence over email_address."
    },
    "template_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Template Id",
      "examples": [
        "e3f1c4a2d5b711ebb5e0242ac130002a"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the template to share"
    },
    "email_address": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Email Address",
      "format": "email",
      "examples": [
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "Email of the account to grant access. Ignored if account_id is provided."
    },
    "skip_notification": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Skip Notification",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, suppresses the email notification sent when sharing the template."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for granting an account access to a template."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_BULK_CREATE_EMBEDDED_SIG_REQ_WITH_TEMPLATE
Tool to create a BulkSendJob for embedded templated signature requests. Use when you need to send up to 250 embedded signature requests at once via one or more templates for iFrame signing.

## DROPBOX_SIGN_CANCEL_SIGNATURE_REQUEST
Cancels an incomplete signature request. Use when you need to cancel a pending signature request that has not been completed. The operation is asynchronous and not reversible - once canceled, the signature request cannot be restored.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CancelSignatureRequestRequest",
  "required": [
    "signature_request_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "signature_request_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Signature Request Id",
      "examples": [
        "69051d323301791ac8a1354807a74e0672aeb9e3"
      ],
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The id of the SignatureRequest to cancel. Must be a valid signature request ID (40-character hexadecimal string). Note: This operation is asynchronous and not reversible."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for canceling an incomplete signature request."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "CancelSignatureRequestResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "CancelSignatureRequestResponse",
      "properties": {},
      "description": "Response model for canceling a signature request. The API returns an empty object on successful cancellation.\nThe operation is asynchronous and actual cancellation is confirmed via callback events."
    }
  },
  "title": "CancelSignatureRequestResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {},
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_CREATE_API_APP

```json
  "type": "object",
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_CREATE_EMBEDDED_SIGNATURE_REQUEST
Tool to create an embedded signature request for signing in an iFrame. Use when you need to initiate a signature request that will be signed within your application rather than via email links.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateEmbeddedSignatureRequestRequest",
  "required": [
    "client_id",
    "signers"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "files": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "FileUploadable",
        "required": [
          "name",
          "mimetype",
          "s3key"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Name",
            "examples": [
              "document.pdf",
              "image.jpg",
              "report.docx"
            ],
            "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
          },
          "s3key": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "S3Key",
            "examples": [
              "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
            ],
            "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_CREATE_EMBEDDED_SIGNATURE_REQUEST_WITH_TEMPLATE
Tool to create an embedded signature request based on a template. Use when you need to initiate a new signature request for embedded signing using pre-defined templates. Returns signature request details including signing URLs for embedded iFrame integration.

**Input schema:**

## DROPBOX_SIGN_CREATE_EMBEDDED_TEMPLATE_DRAFT
Tool to create an embedded template draft. Use when initiating an embedded template workflow where users can edit the template in an iframe before finalizing it.

**Input schema:**

```json
{

          "s3key"

          },
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_CREATE_REPORT
Request creation of CSV report(s) for a specified date range. Reports are generated asynchronously and delivered via email. Available report types: user_activity (account activity), document_status (signature request status), sms_activity (SMS delivery info). You can request up to 2 report types per call. Date range can be up to 12 months, with start_date no more than 10 years in the past. Note: This feature may require a paid plan.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateReportRequest",
  "required": [
    "start_date",
    "end_date",
    "report_type"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "end_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "End Date",
      "examples": [
        "12/31/2023"
      ],
      "description": "Inclusive end date in MM/DD/YYYY format."
    },
    "start_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start Date",
      "examples": [
        "01/01/2023"
      ],
      "description": "Inclusive start date in MM/DD/YYYY format. Date range may be up to 12 months; start_date must not be more than 10 years in the past."
    },
    "report_type": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "enum": [
          "user_activity",
          "document_status",
          "sms_activity"
        ],
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Report Type",
      "examples": [
        [
          "user_activity",
          "document_status"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Type(s) of report to create. Allowed values: 'user_activity', 'document_status', 'sms_activity'. Up to two report types may be requested."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating one or more CSV reports within a date range."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_CREATE_TEMPLATE
Tool to create a reusable template for document signing workflows. Use when you need to establish a template with pre-defined form fields, signer roles, and documents.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateTemplateRequest",
  "required": [
    "title",
    "form_fields_per_document"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "files": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "FileUploadable",
        "required": [
          "name",
          "mimetype",
          "s3key"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Name",
            "examples": [
              "document.pdf",
              "image.jpg",
              "report.docx"
            ],
            "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
          },
          "s3key": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "S3Key",
            "examples": [
              "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
            ],
            "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
          },
          "mimetype": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Mimetype",
            "examples": [
              "application/pdf",
              "image/jpeg",
              "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
            ],
            "description": "The MIME type of the file"
          }
        },
        "file_uploadable": true
      },
      "title": "Files",
      "description": "PDF files to upload for the template. At least one file source (files or file_urls) required."
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "description": "The template's name"
    },
    "message": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message",
      "description": "Email message body for signature requests"
    },
    "subject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subject",
      "description": "Email subject line for signature requests"
    },
    "cc_roles": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Cc Roles",
      "description": "CC recipient role names"
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "description": "Key-value metadata attached to the template (max 10 pairs)",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "client_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Client Id",
      "description": "Client account identifier for template association"
    },
    "file_urls": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "File Urls",
      "description": "URLs pointing to existing PDFs. At least one file source (files or file_urls) required."
    },
    "test_mode": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Test Mode",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether to create in test/sandbox mode"
    },
    "skip_me_now": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Skip Me Now",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Skip creator from signing even if included in signer roles"
    },
    "signer_roles": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "SignerRole",
        "required": [
          "name",
          "order"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Name",
            "description": "Name of the signer role"
          },
          "order": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Order",
            "minimum": 0,
            "description": "Signing order for this role (0-indexed)"
          }
        },
        "description": "Signer role definition for the template."
      },
      "title": "Signer Roles",
      "description": "Defines signer role names and signing order. Required if form fields reference signers."
    },
    "use_preexisting_fields": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Use Preexisting Fields",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Use pre-existing form fields from uploaded PDF if available"
    },
    "form_fields_per_document": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "FormField",
        "required": [
          "type",
          "api_id",
          "document_index",
          "signer",
          "x",
          "y",
          "width",
          "height",
          "page",
          "required"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "x": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "X",
            "minimum": 0,
            "description": "X coordinate of the field on the page"
          },
          "y": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Y",
            "minimum": 0,
            "description": "Y coordinate of the field on the page"
          },
          "page": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Page",
            "minimum": 1,
            "description": "Page number where the field appears (1-indexed)"
          },
          "type": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Type",
            "description": "Field type: 'signature', 'text', 'date_signed', 'checkbox', 'initials', 'dropdown', 'radio', 'hyperlink', etc."
          },
          "group": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Group",
            "description": "Group name if field belongs to a group"
          },
          "width": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Width",
            "minimum": 1,
            "description": "Width of the field in pixels"
          },
          "api_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Api Id",
            "pattern": "^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,64}$",
            "description": "Unique API identifier for this field"
          },
          "height": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Height",
            "minimum": 1,
            "description": "Height of the field in pixels"
          },
          "signer": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Signer",
            "minimum": 0,
            "description": "Index of the signer role (from signer_roles array) who fills this field"
          },
          "required": {
            "type": "boolean",
            "title": "Required",
            "description": "Whether the field is required"
          },
          "document_index": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Document Index",
            "minimum": 0,
            "description": "Zero-based index of the document this field belongs to"
          },
          "validation_type": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Validation Type",
            "description": "Validation type for text fields (e.g., 'numbers_only', 'letters_only')"
          }
        },
        "description": "Form field definition for template documents."
      },
      "title": "Form Fields Per Document",
      "description": "Required array of form field objects defining where and how fields appear. At least one field required."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating a reusable template."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_CREATE_UNCLAIMED_DRAFT
Tool to create an unclaimed draft that can be claimed via a unique URL. Use when you need to prepare a signature request or document send that will be finalized later by someone else through the claim URL.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateUnclaimedDraftRequest",
  "required": [
    "type"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "type": {
      "enum": [
        "send_document",
        "request_signature"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "description": "Draft type: 'send_document' allows document sending without signatures, 'request_signature' requires signers and enables signature collection"
    },
    "files": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "FileUploadable",
        "required": [
          "name",
          "mimetype",
          "s3key"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Name",
            "examples": [
              "document.pdf",
              "image.jpg",
              "report.docx"
            ],
            "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
          },
          "s3key": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "S3Key",
            "examples": [
              "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
            ],
            "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
          },
          "mimetype": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Mimetype",
            "examples": [
              "application/pdf",
              "image/jpeg",
              "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
            ],
            "description": "The MIME type of the file"
          }
        },
        "file_uploadable": true
      },
      "title": "Files",
      "description": "PDF/document files to upload; use files or file_urls, not both."
    },
    "message": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message",
      "maxLength": 5000,
      "description": "Custom message included in signature request email"
    },
    "signers": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {

          },
          "order": {

          },
          "email_address": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Email Address",
            "format": "email",
            "description": "Signer email address"
          }
        },
        "description": "Signer information for request_signature type drafts."
      },
      "title": "Signers",
      "description": "Array of signer objects with name, email_address, and order; required when type is 'request_signature'"
    },
    "subject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subject",
      "maxLength": 255,
      "description": "Email subject line for the signature request"
    },

      "title": "Metadata",

        "type": "string"
      }
    },

      "type": "string",

        "type": "string"
      },

    },
    "test_mode": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Test Mode",

      "description": "If true, the draft/request will be in test mode and not legally binding"
    },
    "allow_decline": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Decline",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Allow signers to decline signing the request"
    },
    "use_text_tags": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Use Text Tags",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Enable parsing of text tags in uploaded documents"
    },
    "allow_reassign": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Reassign",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Allow signers to reassign the signature request to another person"
    },
    "hide_text_tags": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Hide Text Tags",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Remove text tags from final signed document if set to true"
    },
    "form_field_rules": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": true
      },
      "title": "Form Field Rules",
      "description": "Conditional logic rules controlling field visibility based on other field values"
    },
    "form_field_groups": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": true
      },
      "title": "Form Field Groups",
      "description": "Form field group definitions for organizing related fields together"
    },
    "cc_email_addresses": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "format": "email"
      },
      "title": "Cc Email Addresses",
      "description": "Email addresses to receive a copy of all signer emails"
    },
    "signing_redirect_url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Signing Redirect Url",
      "description": "URL to redirect signers after completing signature"
    },
    "show_progress_stepper": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show Progress Stepper",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Display progress stepper UI; set to false to hide"
    },
    "use_preexisting_fields": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Use Preexisting Fields",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Set to true to enable auto-detection of merge fields from the document; only applicable for 'send_document' type"
    },
    "requesting_redirect_url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Requesting Redirect Url",
      "description": "URL to redirect the requester after finalizing the draft (for embedded flows)"
    },
    "form_fields_per_document": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": true
      },
      "title": "Form Fields Per Document",
      "description": "Predefined form field placements across uploaded documents; each entry defines fields for one document"
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for creating an unclaimed draft."
}
```

```json
  "type": "object",
```

```json
    "client_id"
  ],
```

```json
      "type": "array",

          "s3key"

          "name": {

            "title": "Name",

              "image.jpg",
              "report.docx"

            "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"

            "type": "string",
            "title": "S3Key",
            "examples": [
              "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
            ],
            "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
          },
          "mimetype": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Mimetype",
            "examples": [
              "application/pdf",
              "image/jpeg",
              "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
            ],
            "description": "The MIME type of the file"
          }
        },
        "file_uploadable": true
      },
      "title": "Files",
      "description": "Files to upload; use files or file_urls, not both."
    },

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "maxLength": 255,
      "description": "Title for the signature request"
    },

      "title": "Message",
      "maxLength": 5000,
      "description": "Custom message to signers"
    },
    "signers": {
      "type": "array",

        "type": "object",
        "title": "SubSigner",
        "required": [
          "email_address",
          "name"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Name",
            "description": "Signer name"
          },
          "order": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Order",
            "description": "Zero-based signing order for sequential signing"
          },
          "email_address": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Email Address",
            "format": "email",
            "description": "Signer email address"
          }
        }
      },
      "title": "Signers",
      "description": "List of signer definitions; use signers or grouped_signers, not both."
    },
    "subject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subject",
      "maxLength": 255,
      "description": "Email subject for signers"
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "description": "Up to 10 custom key/value metadata entries (keys <=40 chars, values <=1000 chars)",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "client_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Client Id",
      "examples": [
        "12345678901234567890123456789012"
      ],
      "maxLength": 32,
      "minLength": 32,
      "description": "Client ID for embedded signing (must be exactly 32 characters). Get this from your API app settings at sign.dropbox.com"
    },
    "file_urls": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_EDIT_AND_RESEND_SIGNATURE_REQUEST
Edits and resends an existing non-templated signature request with updated documents, signers, or settings. Use this tool when you need to modify an already-created signature request and resend it to signers. Note: This will reset signatures - anyone who already signed will need to sign again. Important: Edit and resend operations deduct from your signature request quota. Required: You must provide either 'files' or 'file_urls' (not both) and either 'signers' or 'grouped_signers' (not both).

## DROPBOX_SIGN_EDIT_AND_RESEND_UNCLAIMED_DRAFT
Tool to edit and resend a previously created unclaimed draft. Use when you have an existing signature_request_id and want to modify the draft before reissuing.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "EditAndResendUnclaimedDraftRequest",
  "required": [
    "signature_request_id",
    "client_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "client_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Client Id",
      "maxLength": 32,
      "minLength": 32,
      "description": "Client ID of the app used to create the draft; applies app branding and callback URL (must be exactly 32 characters)"
    },
    "test_mode": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Test Mode",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, created request is not legally binding"
    },
    "editor_options": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Editor Options",
      "description": "Options for the built-in document editor while preparing the draft",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "signature_request_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Signature Request Id",
      "maxLength": 40,
      "minLength": 40,
      "description": "ID of the signature request to edit and resend (must be exactly 40 characters)"
    },
    "signing_redirect_url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Signing Redirect Url",
      "description": "URL to redirect signers after they successfully sign"
    },
    "show_progress_stepper": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show Progress Stepper",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Show progress stepper; set to false to hide when only one step remains"
    },
    "is_for_embedded_signing": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is For Embedded Signing",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, the resulting request will be signable in embedded mode"
    },
    "requester_email_address": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Requester Email Address",
      "format": "email",
      "description": "Email to designate as the requester; defaults to the original requester if not set"
    },
    "requesting_redirect_url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Requesting Redirect Url",
      "description": "URL to redirect users after they successfully request a signature"
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for editing and resending an unclaimed draft."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_EDIT_RESEND_EMBEDDED_SIGNATURE_REQUEST_TEMPLATE
Tool to edit and resend an embedded signature request using templates. Use when you need to update request details or recipients and resend within an embedded signing flow.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "EditAndResendEmbeddedSignatureRequestWithTemplateRequest",
  "required": [
    "signature_request_id",
    "client_id",
    "template_ids",
    "signers"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "ccs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "SubCC",
        "required": [
          "role",
          "email_address"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "role": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Role",
            "minLength": 1,
            "description": "Template role name for this CC recipient"
          },
          "email_address": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Email Address",
            "format": "email",
            "description": "CC recipient\u2019s email address"
          }
        }
      },
      "title": "Ccs",
      "description": "CC recipients matching any CC roles in template"
    },
    "files": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "FileUploadable",
        "required": [
          "name",
          "mimetype",
          "s3key"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Name",
            "examples": [
              "document.pdf",
              "image.jpg",
              "report.docx"
            ],
            "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
          },
          "s3key": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "S3Key",
            "examples": [
              "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
            ],
            "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
          },
          "mimetype": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Mimetype",
            "examples": [
              "application/pdf",
              "image/jpeg",
              "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
            ],
            "description": "The MIME type of the file"
          }
        },
        "file_uploadable": true
      },
      "title": "Files",
      "description": "Binary file uploads; mutually exclusive with file_urls"
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "maxLength": 255,
      "description": "Title for the signature request (max 255 chars)"
    },
    "message": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message",
      "maxLength": 5000,
      "description": "Custom email message to signers (max 5000 chars)"
    },

            "type": "string",
            "title": "Name",
            "minLength": 1,
            "description": "Signer\u2019s full name"
          },
          "role": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Role",
            "minLength": 1,
            "description": "Template role name for this signer"
          },
          "order": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Order",
            "description": "Signing order for this signer"
          },
          "email_address": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Email Address",
            "format": "email",
            "description": "Signer\u2019s email address"
          }
        }
      },
      "title": "Signers",
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Signer definitions matching template roles"
    },
    "subject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subject",
      "maxLength": 255,
      "description": "Email subject to signers (max 255 chars)"
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "description": "Key/value metadata (\u226410 keys, values \u22641000 chars)",
      "propertyNames": {
        "maxLength": 40
      },
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string",
        "maxLength": 1000
      }
    },
    "client_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Client Id",
      "maxLength": 32,
      "minLength": 32,

    },
    "file_urls": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "File Urls",
      "description": "URLs for Dropbox Sign to fetch file(s); mutually exclusive with files"
    },
    "test_mode": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Test Mode",
      "default": false,

      },

          "title": "Default Type",
          "description": "Default signature type to present"

      },

      "additionalProperties": false

    "signature_request_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Signature Request Id",
      "maxLength": 40,
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_GET_ACCOUNT
Retrieves detailed information about a Dropbox Sign account including quotas, payment status, and settings. Use this tool to: - Check account quota limits (API requests, documents, templates remaining) - Verify account payment status (paid vs free tier) - Get account settings (SMS delivery, authentication options) - Retrieve account identifiers and contact information Requires either account_id (40-character identifier) or email_address, but not both.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAccountRequest",
  "properties": {
    "account_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Account Id",
      "examples": [
        "a5be022c9f7f27139f1103d66a981e6e089ff22e"
      ],
      "maxLength": 40,
      "minLength": 40,
      "description": "The ID of the account (must be exactly 40 characters). Provide either account_id or email_address, but not both."
    },
    "email_address": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Email Address",
      "format": "email",
      "examples": [
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "The email address of the account. Provide either account_id or email_address, but not both."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving Dropbox Sign account details."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_GET_API_APP
Tool to retrieve information about an API App by its client ID. Use when you need to fetch API App configuration, OAuth settings, white labeling options, or owner details.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "required": [
    "client_id"
  ],
  "properties": {

      "title": "Client Id",
      "examples": [
        "a731cc2f68ff910bdee67689884eb804"
      ],
      "description": "The client ID of the API App to retrieve. This unique identifier is assigned when the app is created."
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_GET_BULK_SEND_JOB
Tool to retrieve the status of a bulk send job. Use when you need up-to-date job progress and request details.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetBulkSendJobRequest",
  "required": [
    "bulk_send_job_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "page": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page",
      "default": 1,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        1
      ],
      "description": "Page number of the Bulk Send Job signature requests to return. Defaults to 1."
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "default": 20,
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        20
      ],
      "description": "Number of signature requests per page (1-100). Defaults to 20."
    },
    "bulk_send_job_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Bulk Send Job Id",
      "examples": [
        "6e683bc0369ba3d5b6f43c2c22a8031dbf6bd174"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the Bulk Send Job to retrieve."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a Bulk Send Job."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_GET_CURRENT_TEAM
Tool to get the current team membership status and details. Use when you need to check if the authenticated user is part of a team and retrieve team information. Returns is_on_team False if user is not part of any team (no retries needed for this case).

## DROPBOX_SIGN_GET_EMBEDDED_SIGN_URL
Retrieves an embedded signing URL for a specific signer's signature. Use this after creating an embedded signature request to get a temporary URL that can be embedded in an iFrame for the signer to complete signing. The URL expires after 60 minutes or upon first access, but you can generate a new URL anytime using the same signature_id. Note: Requires the signature_id (per signer), not the signature_request_id.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetEmbeddedSignUrlRequest",
  "required": [
    "signature_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "signature_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Signature Id",
      "examples": [
        "50e3542f738adfa7ddd4cbd4c00d2a8a"
      ],
      "description": "The 32-character signature ID (not signature_request_id) obtained from creating an embedded signature request. Each signer has a unique signature_id."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving an embedded signing URL."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_GET_EMBEDDED_TEMPLATE_EDIT_URL
Tool to generate an edit URL for embedded template editing. Use after selecting or uploading a template to allow users to modify it in an iframe.

**Input schema:**
```json
{

  "required": [

      "type": "array",

    },

      "description": "ID of the template to generate an edit URL for."
    },
    "merge_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "SubMergeField",
        "required": [
          "name"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Name",
            "description": "Name of the merge field in the template."
          },
          "value": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Value",
            "description": "Value to pre-fill for this merge field."
          }
        },
        "description": "Merge field definition for prefilling data in the template."
      },
      "title": "Merge Fields",
      "description": "Merge fields to prefill; pass empty list to clear all existing."
    },
    "preview_only": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Preview Only",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Preview-only mode with no adding fields; overrides show_preview."
    },
    "show_preview": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show Preview",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Enable the editor preview experience."
    },
    "allow_edit_ccs": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Edit Ccs",

    "force_subject_message": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Force Subject Message",

      "description": "Allow users to review or edit email subject and message."
    },
    "show_progress_stepper": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show Progress Stepper",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Show the progress stepper unless only one step remains."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for generating an embedded template edit URL."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_GET_SIGNATURE_REQUEST
Retrieves the current status and complete details of a signature request by ID. Use this action to: - Check if signers have viewed, signed, or declined the request - Get signer information and signature timestamps - Access form field responses and custom field values - Retrieve URLs for document downloads and management - Monitor signature request progress and completion status Returns detailed information including signer names, emails, signing status, custom fields, response data, attachments, and signing options. Handles errors gracefully with structured error responses for invalid or non-existent signature request IDs.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSignatureRequestRequest",
  "required": [
    "signature_request_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "signature_request_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Signature Request Id",
      "examples": [
        "fa5c8a0b0f492d768749333ad6fcc214c111e967"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the signature request to retrieve (40-character hex string). Obtain this ID from the response when creating a signature request or from the list signature requests endpoint."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving a signature request's status and details."
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_GET_SIGNATURE_REQUEST_FILES_AS_DATA_URI
Tool to download signature request files as a base64-encoded data URI. Use when you need the document content as a data URI string for embedding or transmission. Returns immediately if files are ready (status 200), or indicates if files are still being prepared (status 409).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSignatureRequestFilesAsDataUriRequest",
  "required": [
    "signature_request_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "signature_request_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Signature Request Id",
      "examples": [
        "fa5c8a0b0f492d768749333ad6fcc214c111e967"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the SignatureRequest to retrieve files for as data URI. This is a 40-character hex string obtained when creating a signature request or from the list signature requests endpoint."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving signature request files as base64-encoded data URI."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {

      "properties": {
        "message": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Message",
          "description": "Additional message about the request status, especially useful when files are still being processed."
        },
        "data_uri": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Data Uri",
          "description": "File as base64 encoded string. If null, files are still being processed (check status_code)."
        },
        "status_code": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Status Code",
          "description": "HTTP status code from the API response. 200 indicates success, 409 indicates files are still being prepared."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response model containing the signature request files as base64-encoded data URI."
    }
  },
  "title": "GetSignatureRequestFilesAsDataUriResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {
        "message": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Message",
          "description": "Additional message about the request status, especially useful when files are still being processed."
        },
        "data_uri": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Data Uri",
          "description": "File as base64 encoded string. If null, files are still being processed (check status_code)."
        },
        "status_code": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Status Code",
          "description": "HTTP status code from the API response. 200 indicates success, 409 indicates files are still being prepared."
        }
      },
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_GET_SIGNATURE_REQUEST_FILES_AS_FILE_URL
Retrieves a copy of the current documents and returns a JSON object with a URL to the file (PDFs only). Use this action when you need a temporary download link for signature request documents instead of downloading the files directly. The returned URL will expire after a certain time period indicated by the expires_at field.

```json
  "type": "object",

  },

}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_GET_TEAM_INFO
Retrieves information about a Dropbox Sign team, including team name, member count, and sub-team count. Use when you need to get team details. If team_id is provided, retrieves info for that specific team; otherwise retrieves info for the authenticated user's team.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTeamInfoRequest",
  "properties": {
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "examples": [
        "abcd1234-12ab-34cd-56ef-123456abcdef"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the team to retrieve information for. Optional \u2014 if omitted, the API will return information for the authenticated user's team."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving information about a Dropbox Sign team."
}
```

```json
        },
```

```json
        "zip"

      "examples": [
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_LIST_BULK_SEND_JOBS
Tool to list bulk send jobs. Use when you need to retrieve all bulk send job summaries the authenticated user can access. Supports pagination via page and page_size.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListBulkSendJobsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "page": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page",
      "default": 1,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        1
      ],
      "description": "Page number of the Bulk Send Job list (default 1)."
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "default": 20,
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        20
      ],
      "description": "Number of Bulk Send Jobs to return per page (1\u2013100, default 20)."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing Bulk Send Jobs with pagination."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_LIST_FAX_LINES

**Input schema:**

## DROPBOX_SIGN_LIST_SIGNATURE_REQUESTS
Tool to list signature requests. Use when you need to retrieve paginated signature requests with optional filters.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListSignatureRequestsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "page": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page",
      "default": 1,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        1
      ],
      "description": "Page number to return."
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "examples": [
        "from:me title:Agreement"
      ],
      "description": "Search string with optional fielded filters (e.g., 'from:me AND complete:true')."
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "default": 20,
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        20
      ],
      "description": "Number of objects per page, between 1 and 100."
    },
    "account_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Account Id",
      "examples": [
        "all"
      ],
      "description": "Team account to list requests for; use 'all' for all team members; defaults to your account."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for listing signature requests with optional filters."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_LIST_SUB_TEAMS
Lists all sub-teams belonging to a parent team with pagination support. Returns team identifiers and names for each sub-team. Use this to discover the organizational structure of teams within Dropbox Sign. Requires a valid team_id from the parent team. Returns empty list if the team has no sub-teams or if team features are not available for the account.

**Input schema:**

```json
  ],
  "properties": {

      "default": 1,
      "minimum": 1,

      ],
      "description": "Page number to return; minimum is 1; default is 1."

    "team_id": {

      "title": "Team Id",
      "examples": [

      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the parent team whose sub-teams you want to list."
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "default": 20,
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        20
      ],
      "description": "Number of items per page; range is 1 to 100; default is 20."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing sub-teams of a parent team."
}
```

```json
      ],

      "title": "Page Size",
```
```json
      "default": 20,
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [

      ],
```

```json
    },
    "account_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Account Id",
      "examples": [
        "all"
      ],
      "description": "Team member account to return templates for; use 'all' for all members; defaults to your account."

}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_O_AUTH_AUTHORIZE
Tool to generate an OAuth authorization URL. Use before directing the user to grant access.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "OAuthAuthorizeRequest",
  "required": [
    "state"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "scope": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Scope",
      "examples": [
        "account_access signature_request_access template_access"
      ],
      "description": "Optional space-delimited list of OAuth scopes. If omitted, default scopes for the app are used."
    },
    "state": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "State",
      "examples": [
        "user-login-123"
      ],
      "description": "Opaque value used to maintain state between the request and callback. Must be unique per auth request."
    },
    "client_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Client Id",
      "examples": [
        "abcd1234efgh5678"
      ],
      "description": "Client ID of the Dropbox Sign API app. If not provided, the value from connection metadata will be used."
    },
    "redirect_uri": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Redirect Uri",
      "examples": [
        "https://example.com/oauth/callback"
      ],
      "description": "Optional redirect URI to which the OAuth server will send the user after authorization. Must match a configured callback URL if provided."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for initiating the OAuth authorization flow."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "OAuthAuthorizeResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "OAuthAuthorizeResponse",
      "required": [
        "authorization_url"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "authorization_url": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Authorization Url",
          "description": "URL where the user should be redirected to grant OAuth consent."
        }
      },
      "description": "Contains the generated OAuth authorization URL."
    }
  },
  "title": "OAuthAuthorizeResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "authorization_url"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "authorization_url": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Authorization Url",
          "description": "URL where the user should be redirected to grant OAuth consent."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_RELEASE_SIGNATURE_REQUEST_HOLD
Release a held signature request to send it to signers. Use this when a signature request was created from an unclaimed draft with hold_request=true and has been claimed but not yet sent. After releasing, the request will be sent to all designated signers.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ReleaseSignatureRequestHoldRequest",
  "required": [
    "signature_request_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "signature_request_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Signature Request Id",
      "examples": [
        "fa5c8a0b0f492d768749333ad6fcc214c111e967"
      ],
      "maxLength": 40,
      "minLength": 40,
      "description": "ID of the held Signature Request to release. Must be exactly 40 characters long."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for releasing a held Signature Request."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_REMOVE_USER_FROM_TEMPLATE
Tool to remove an account's access to a template. Use when you need to revoke a user's permission on a template after confirming template ID and target account.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RemoveUserFromTemplateRequest",
  "required": [
    "template_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "account_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Account Id",
      "examples": [
        "a5be022c9f7f27139f1103d66a981e6e089ff22e"
      ],
      "maxLength": 40,
      "minLength": 40,
      "description": "ID of the account to revoke access (must be 40 characters long). Takes precedence over email_address."
    },
    "template_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Template Id",
      "description": "ID of the template from which to remove access."
    },
    "email_address": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Email Address",
      "format": "email",
      "examples": [
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "Email of the account to revoke access. Ignored if account_id is provided."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for revoking an account's access to a template."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_SEND_SIGNATURE_REQUEST
Tool to create and send a new signature request with documents. Use when you need to send documents for electronic signature. The action sends emails to all specified signers with links to view and sign the documents. Supports multiple signers, CC recipients, custom fields, form fields, and various signing options. Documents can be uploaded directly or provided via publicly accessible URLs.

**Input schema:**

## DROPBOX_SIGN_SEND_SIGNATURE_REQUEST_REMINDER
Sends an email reminder to a signer about a pending signature request. Use this when a signer needs a reminder to complete their signature. Important constraints: - Cannot send a reminder within 1 hour of the last reminder (automatic or manual) - Cannot be used with embedded signature requests - The signature request must exist and not be completed - The email address must match a signer on the request

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SendSignatureRequestReminderRequest",
  "required": [
    "signature_request_id",
    "email_address"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Alice Smith"
      ],
      "description": "Name of the signer. Required only when multiple signers on the request share the same email address, to disambiguate which signer to remind."
    },
    "email_address": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Email Address",
      "format": "email",
      "examples": [
        "alice@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "Email address of the signer who should receive the reminder. Must match an existing signer on the signature request."
    },
    "signature_request_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Signature Request Id",
      "examples": [
        "fa5c8a0b0f492d768749333ad6fcc214c111e967"
      ],
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The unique ID of the signature request (40-character hexadecimal string). Get this from list or get signature request endpoints."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for sending a reminder email to a signer for an outstanding signature request."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_UPDATE_ACCOUNT
Tool to update Dropbox Sign account properties and settings. Use when you need to modify callback URLs or locale settings for an account.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateAccountRequest",
  "properties": {
    "locale": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Locale",
      "examples": [
        "en_US"
      ],
      "description": "The locale used in the account (e.g., 'en_US', 'de_DE', 'fr_FR')."
    },
    "account_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Account Id",
      "examples": [
        "a5be022c9f7f27139f1103d66a981e6e089ff22e"
      ],
      "maxLength": 40,
      "minLength": 40,
      "description": "The ID of the account to update (must be exactly 40 characters)."
    },
    "callback_url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Callback Url",
      "examples": [
        "https://example.com/callback"
      ],
      "description": "The URL that Dropbox Sign should POST events to. Set to empty string to remove."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for updating Dropbox Sign account properties."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_UPDATE_API_APP
Tool to update an existing API App in Dropbox Sign. Use when you need to modify API App settings such as name, callback URL, domains, OAuth configuration, branding options, or custom logo.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateApiAppRequest",
  "required": [
    "client_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "My API App"
      ],
      "description": "Name to assign to the API App"
    },
    "oauth": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "OAuthConfig",
      "properties": {
        "scopes": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Scopes",
          "description": "List of OAuth scopes for the app"
        },
        "callback_url": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Callback Url",
          "description": "OAuth callback URL for the app"
        }
      },
      "description": "OAuth configuration for API App",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "domains": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Domains",
      "examples": [
        [
          "example.com",
          "app.example.com"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Domain names associated with the app"
    },
    "options": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "AppOptions",
      "properties": {
        "can_insert_everywhere": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Can Insert Everywhere",
          "description": "Whether the app can be inserted everywhere"
        }
      },
      "description": "Options configuration for API App",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "client_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Client Id",
      "examples": [
        "fb9dacffaea5f03718e48eb22511926b"
      ],
      "description": "The client ID of the API App to update"
    },
    "callback_url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Callback Url",
      "examples": [
        "https://example.com/callback"
      ],
      "description": "URL where the API App receives event callbacks"
    },
    "custom_logo_file": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileUploadable",
      "required": [
        "name",
        "mimetype",
        "s3key"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "document.pdf",
            "image.jpg",
            "report.docx"
          ],
          "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
        },
        "s3key": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "S3Key",
          "examples": [
            "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
          ],
          "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
        },
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_UPDATE_SIGNATURE_REQUEST
Updates the email address and/or name for a specific signer on a signature request. Use this when you need to correct or update signer contact information before they complete signing. Important: This endpoint only works for signature requests created with explicit form_fields_per_document (no appended signature page). At least one of email_address or name must be provided.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateSignatureRequestRequest",
  "required": [
    "signature_request_id",
    "signature_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Updated Signer Name"
      ],
      "description": "New name for the signer. Provide this and/or email_address to update."
    },
    "signature_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Signature Id",
      "examples": [
        "d5cf1d061f4f50604a4df2247dd66fac"
      ],
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The signature ID for the signer whose information should be updated. Get this from the signatures list in the signature request object."
    },
    "email_address": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Email Address",
      "format": "email",
      "examples": [
        "updated.signer@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "New email address for the signer. Must be a valid email format. Provide this and/or name to update."
    },
    "signature_request_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Signature Request Id",
      "examples": [
        "c51362a3e019096248fd4b6c2f8e69dbf2763706"
      ],
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The unique ID of the signature request to update (40-character hexadecimal string). Get this from list or get signature request endpoints."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating a signer's email address and/or name on a signature request."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_UPDATE_TEMPLATE_FILES
Tool to update files for an existing template. Overlays new files with the overlay of an existing template. Use when you need to replace the documents in a template while keeping the field configuration. The update is processed asynchronously; completion is communicated via callback events (template_created or template_error).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateTemplateFilesRequest",
  "required": [
    "template_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "files": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "FileUploadable",
        "required": [
          "name",
          "mimetype",
          "s3key"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Name",
            "examples": [
              "document.pdf",
              "image.jpg",
              "report.docx"
            ],
            "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
          },
          "s3key": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "S3Key",
            "examples": [
              "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
            ],
            "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
          },
          "mimetype": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Mimetype",
            "examples": [
              "application/pdf",
              "image/jpeg",
              "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
            ],
            "description": "The MIME type of the file"
          }
        },
        "file_uploadable": true
      },
      "title": "Files",
      "description": "Files to upload for the template. Use either files or file_urls, not both."
    },
    "message": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message",
      "description": "The new default template email message."
    },
    "subject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subject",
      "description": "The new default template email subject."
    },
    "client_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Client Id",
      "description": "Client ID of the app you are using to update the template."
    },
    "file_urls": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "File Urls",
      "description": "URLs for files to use for the template. Dropbox Sign will download these files. Use either file_urls or files, not both."
    },
    "test_mode": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Test Mode",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether this is a test. Signatures will not be legally binding if set to true. Defaults to false."
    },
    "template_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Template Id",
      "examples": [
        "0bf765f428e95d0a0107c2575c761001ea77d7d0"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the template to update files for."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating template files."
}
```

## DROPBOX_SIGN_VERIFY_ACCOUNT
Tool to verify whether a Dropbox Sign account exists for the given email. Use when you need to check account existence before sending signature requests.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "VerifyAccountRequest",
  "required": [
    "email_address"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "email_address": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Email Address",
      "format": "email",
      "examples": [
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "Email address to verify for a Dropbox Sign account."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to verify if a Dropbox Sign account exists for the given email."
}
```
